display_name: How many total servings of caffeine did you have today? [See online guide for the definition of a 'serving']
description:
Please refer to this guide to help calculate servings:
Cola 12 oz (1 can) - 1/2 serving
Tea (1 cup) - 1/2 serving
Home brew coffee 8 oz (1 cup) - 1 serving
Energy drink 16 oz (1 large can) - 2 servings
5 hour energy - 2 servings
Large coffee 16 oz (large or grande) - 2 servings
Caffeine pill - 100mg - 1 serving
Caffeine pill - 200mg - 2 servings
